stage_0.evidenceKind: ordinary reflection execution, not REA Evidence
stage_0.clock: h.run targets a 65ms display period; original i.d increments bv by 50 logical units per update. J and completionWaitUnits use bv units, not wall-clock milliseconds.
stage_0.coordinates: original 240x320 screen pixels; actor x/y already include aC and sampled hit jitter; add appearance frame crop offset; no flip_h
stage_0.composition: sky, native terrain with backgroundOffset, then layers in recorded order; flash overlays entire viewport
stage_0.selection: appearances[id:weapon] -> actionGroup/defenseGroup; clips[actionGroup/defenseGroup/sourceSlot/outcome]; sourceSlot 0 is battle initiator (bT), 1 is original defender/counterattacker (bU), independent of left/right faction
stage_0.effectTails: effectTailTicks continues surviving effect instances after action completion; carry these into the next action using foreground bucket and source insertion order. Fixed-seed tail sampling has no subsequent action's extra random draws.

hpContract.reason: action/effect tracks are independent of HP amount; positive damage changes HP/death and final wait, not action frame/motion state transitions
hpContract.impact: first tick with defender.A=true; sourceSlot0 defender damage begins in that tick, sourceSlot1 begins next tick; attacker recovery begins next tick for both slots
hpContract.hpStepRule: each tick defender HP=max(targetHP,HP-4), attacker recovery=min(targetHP,HP+4); native source fighter update order is bT then bU. Clear A/B in the update reaching the target. Combat rules already clamp damage/recovery to the available HP.
hpContract.death: when defender HP reaches zero: stop defender layer and insert deaths[defenseGroup] at that tick; death layers use aS=false and source insertion order
hpContract.completion: run the source update order: HP/recovery update writes attacker.J=nowUnits; action entry into state5 writes J=nowUnits; attacker state5 tests nowUnits-J>=completionWaitUnits. bv/J advance 50 units per 65ms nominal display tick. sourceSlot0 tests before that tick's defender HP step, sourceSlot1 tests after it.
hpContract.waitDuringDamage: each HP/recovery update sets attacker.J=nowUnits; state5 entry also sets J=nowUnits; physical wait150 is 3 ticks, magic wait500 is 10 ticks
hpContract.lateHold: if HP drain outlasts sampled frames, hold last actor/sky state, advance effectTailTicks and death clip, then omit expired effects
hpContract.scope: single result action; runtime sequences counter/follow-up actions from combat rules. Fixed seed is one original stochastic visual realization, not every random outcome.

选择人物时所表示出来的红色部分是移动范围，将光标点到敌军人物的时候，同样也会出现红色部分，所以就能得知敌人的移动范围。

tutorials.rawText: 你可以按 '*' 将光标切换到我方下一个可以行动的人物身上，当你的光标选中某人物，按 '#' 便可查看人物信息，或者在人物弹出菜单里选'状态'查看。当人物在战斗中取得足够经验值而等级上升后，其各项属性都会大幅增强。
